newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bourse says trade as normal Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bourse says trade as normal Wednesday.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Singapore said on Tuesday that a technical fault in its central computer was being fixed and normal trading should resume on Wednesday.

A stock exchange spokesman confirmed the system broke down at 0825 GMT, preventing the last 35 minutes of trade through the exchange before the 0900 GMT close on Tuesday. She did not give any reason for the technical fault.
Trading on the Singapore bourse is all electronic.
